description: Header file defining the 'phy_metrics_pusch_processor_decorator' class, which decorates a PUSCH processor with metrics collection and notification capabilities within a 3GPP LTE/NR physical layer implementation.

classes.name: phy_metrics_pusch_processor_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for PUSCH processor that adds metrics collection and notification functionality.

methods.name: phy_metrics_pusch_processor_decorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a base PUSCH processor and a metrics notifier.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides the process method to add metrics collection around the base processor's processing.

methods.name: on_uci
methods.description: Handles UCI (Uplink Control Information) reporting, records timing metrics.

methods.name: on_sch
methods.description: Handles scheduling results, records timing metrics, and triggers metric notification.

methods.name: notify_metrics
methods.description: Calculates and reports processing metrics to the notifier once processing is complete.
